glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) — a bow firing an arrow. A hand (攴) was added later, forming 㢭. The hand further turned into the phonetic component 癹, leading to the current form as a phono-semantic compound (形聲).
s_page_origin: Simplified from 發 and 髮 in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme by the People's Republic of China.
note: Composite id: 发 also writes other words; this sign is the 發 sense. glyph_origin is from the 發 page; s_page_origin is the 发 page's own text.
